          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string

          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

            present. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region per the
            fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with
            no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'

          title: Shares household
          description: >-

            owner already has the same last name and address (they share a
            household). Optional; defaults to false. This flag is only a

        - type: object
          properties:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name, assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household (same
                last name and address). Assigned when an owner is registered with
                'sharesHousehold' true so joining members share the value; otherwise
                absent.
              type: string
              example: A1B2C3D4E5F60718
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 derived at create time.
                It starts at 1, gains 1 when an email is present, gains a further 1 when the
                owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), and is capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION segment of the customerCode (the part
                before the '-'), i.e. the region derived from the postcode, or 'UNKNOWN'
                when no customer code is assigned.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first
                name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (i.e.
                already carry the current business day as their registrationDate),
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, the single derived value all duplicate detection
                is based on, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the
                telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is its lower-cased value
                (empty when absent) and the household segment is the householdId (empty when
                the owner does not share a household). A create is rejected with 409 only when
                a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|owner@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate against
                the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the soft-duplicate ("possible duplicate") detection for owner creation.

**The rule:** When a new owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` and `postcode` while carrying a *different* telephone, the owner is still created, with `possibleDuplicate` = `true` and `possibleDuplicateOf` = the matching owner's id; otherwise `possibleDuplicate` = `false` and `possibleDuplicateOf` absent.

**Changes made:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added two read-only fields to the `Owner` schema: `possibleDuplicate` (boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (int32). These regenerate into `OwnerDto` at build time and are what `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns.

2. **`Owner.java`** (entity) — Added persisted `possible_duplicate` / `possible_duplicate_of` columns with getters/setters, so the flags survive the create and are read back on GET. MapStruct maps them automatically by name.

3. **DB schemas** (`h2`, `hsqldb`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — Added the two columns. The test profile uses hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema.sql column was required.

4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Added a `possibleDuplicateOf(owner)` helper (case-insensitive lastName match, exact postcode match, differing telephone; skips owners with no postcode; returns the earliest matching id for determinism) and wired it into `addOwner` just before persisting, after the existing hard-duplicate rejection.

The `AcceptanceTest.coreFlagsPossibleDuplicate` test and the full suite pass.
